title: Kirby Problem 5.16
exact_target: Determine whether three kinds of equivalence of finitely generated differential graded algebras can be decided, in both the noncommutative and graded-commutative settings.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3023 (KP-5.16). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman (eds.), \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295, American Mathematical Society (2026), Problem 5.16, author preliminary version.

Ciprian Manolescu and Nick Rozenblyum, \emph{Undecidability problems for semifree DG algebras}, arXiv:2605.08122v1 (2026), Theorem 1, its coefficient-ring footnote, and §2. Theorem 1 answers all three noncommutative questions negatively for computable coefficient rings; the paper explicitly leaves the graded-commutative alternative open.
